summary: A +- grid is not one table of type table.el.
Prose that matches a radio target is not a link.
A same-line begin/end is not a latex-environment.
A bare script body ending mid-tile drops the entity under the superscript.
An orphaned spaced dual caption is a keyword here, like any orphaned caption, and a paragraph in Org.
A key-side dual on #+call is a babel call here and a keyword in Org.
U+00A0, U+2013, U+2014, U+2019, and U+2026 are dollar followers in Org and not here.
Past the nesting budget the tree flattens.
A rejected angle continuation is not a plain link here. Org still reports https://x.
